author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/42-polaris-nsids.md — Open Questions Q1–Q4.

## What this issue does
Block PR 1 (Lexicon JSON drafts, #101) on a human decision for the four open Qs. Provisional answers from the design doc are recorded in parent epic #99; this issue is the explicit human gate before any Lexicon JSON commits.

## Decisions required
### Q1 — NSID namespace
- A. `gay.dollspace.polaris.*` (first-operator domain) — PROVISIONAL
- B. `org.polaris.*` / `polaris.tools.*` (project-neutral, needs domain registration)
- C. `com.atproto.polaris.*` (colocated with upstream ATProto; needs Bluesky approval)

### Q2 — Type strategy
- A. Parallel types via codegen + mapping (PROVISIONAL)
- B. Hand-written shared type (one struct serves both)
- C. Tag the existing table (serde adapter for wire emission)

### Q3 — v2 NSID record scope
- A. All four (incident, observation, escalation, evidence-pointer)
- B. `escalation` + embedded observation/evidence-pointer only — PROVISIONAL
- C. `escalation` only, opaque subject refs

### Q4 — Subject identity across instances
- A. ATProto-shaped subjects only (DID / AT-URI) — PROVISIONAL
- B. Polaris-shaped `SubjectId` + side metadata record
- C. Structured union with `kind` discriminant

## Rust-quality notes
- This is a decision issue, not an implementation issue. No code lands here.
- Decisions get recorded as `--kind decision` comments on this issue.
- Once all four are decided, this issue closes and PR 1 (#101) unblocks.

## External references
- ATProto NSID conventions: https://atproto.com/specs/nsid
- proto-blue-codegen rename ergonomics: in-repo at `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-codegen/README.md`

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-Q1: NSID namespace decided + recorded as a `--kind decision` comment.
- [ ] AC-Q2: Type strategy decided + recorded.
- [ ] AC-Q3: v2 record scope decided + recorded.
- [ ] AC-Q4: Subject identity rule decided + recorded.

## Blocks
- Blocks #101 (PR 1 — Lexicon JSON drafts; the namespace + scope answers shape the file set).
